method: Fixed action (cand=0, bomb=0, 2-frame decisions) on stage 0 / normal / team 0; seeds 1,2,3; compare all 25 STATE fields at every decision and ignore only the rng_seed field itself, because rng_seed is tracked and would otherwise make any cross-seed hash differ at frame 0. No training, no data capture.

first_life.result: no non-rng divergence across seeds 1/2/3 in the first 700 frames; still dies at frame 706, before any seed-dependent event

findings: The first 700 frames of stage 0 with a fixed action are bit-identical across seeds 1/2/3 except for the tracked rng_seed field; the first life is seed-invariant on this path.

Seed-dependent gameplay first appears after the first death/respawn: about frame 906-952 with standard resources and 970-1078 with practice resources (score/stage_generation first, then graze/power/items).

Therefore any episode that ends before roughly frame 1,000 on this path is not an independent environment-seed sample: different seeds produce the same trajectory. Counting such episodes as 3 or 100 independent samples overstates the effective sample size.
The baseline rows' three seeds differ only through the policy's own RNG (random) or not at all (still/fixed); they must not be used as evidence of environment-seed independence.

G1 teacher episodes survive to ~13k frames and their frames varied across seeds 1000-1019; that is consistent with the seed lever becoming active after the first respawn, not with seeds being globally inert.

Formal G410 suites must report the first seed-divergence frame for their policy/segment and count effective independent episodes; a suite whose episodes end before that frame must be treated as one trajectory, not N seeds.

policy_rule.name: seed_sensitivity_rule
policy_rule.rule: Before using a set of seeds as independent samples, record the first non-rng state divergence frame for the policy/segment. Episodes ending before that frame are duplicates for denominator purposes; count them once and report the duplication explicitly.
policy_rule.effective_sample_formula: effective_n = number of distinct trajectories after grouping episodes that never reach the first divergence frame
policy_rule.not_a_gate: This is a denominator rule and a warning; it does not by itself pass or fail a capability gate.

limitations: Only stage 0 / normal / team 0 and a fixed action were probed.
The exact first-divergence frame is path-dependent; every policy/segment must be calibrated, not assumed.
The probe compares the 25 tracked STATE fields; it does not compare enemy/bullet memory that is not exported.
No teacher or student was run for this probe; the G1 observation is cited as context, not re-measured here.
